I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The depot was Southgate.

Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later she said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident. Neither of us wrote down a street address.

The gbrain search was refused because its connection token isn't linked to any member, so nothing came back from it. To fix it, someone on the brain host would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`, or set it up to act on behalf of named members.
